description.en: The ID of the NAS file system.
The domain name of the mount target.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

title.zh: 修改NAS文件系统的挂载点

descriptions.zh: 创建NAS文件系统时，系统将自动生成一个挂载点。默认情况下，该挂载点无需修改，如果该挂载点被误操作删除，您需要重新为该办公网络的NAS文件系统指定一个新的挂载点。您可以调用[CreateMountTarget](~~62621~~)来创建挂载点。
descriptions.en: When you create a NAS file system, a mount target is automatically generated. By default, the mount target does not need to be changed. If the mount target is deleted by misoperation, you must specify a new mount target for the NAS file system in the workspace. You can call the [CreateMountTarget](~~62621~~) operation to create a mount target.
